definitions.gloss: approval or disapproval; yes or no; propriety
definitions.explanation: Whether something is acceptable or not; the question of approval versus rejection. Composed of 可 (acceptable, permissible) + 否 (not, negative). Used in formal and business contexts to discuss whether something should be approved or whether it is appropriate.

examples.japanese: {参加|さんか}の{可否|かひ}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please let us know whether you can attend.

examples.japanese: この{提案|ていあん}の{可否|かひ}を{委員会|いいんかい}で{議論|ぎろん}する。
examples.english: The committee will discuss whether to approve this proposal.

examples.japanese: {撮影|さつえい}の{可否|かひ}については、{事前|じぜん}に{施設|しせつ}に{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check with the facility in advance regarding whether photography is permitted.

notes:
USAGE:
{可否|かひ} is a formal word used mainly in written communication, business emails, and official documents. In everyday speech, people would simply ask できるかどうか or いいかどうか instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参加|さんか}の{可否|かひ} (whether one can participate)
- {可否|かひ}を{問|と}う (to question the propriety of)
- {可否|かひ}を{判断|はんだん}する (to judge approval/disapproval)
- {撮影|さつえい}{可否|かひ} (whether photography is allowed)
- {出席|しゅっせき}の{可否|かひ} (whether one can attend)
